I am an old man with no schooling, and this small plot is for beans mixed with other crops. I do not have money for fertilizer on beans — the little fertilizer I might get from FISP I would put on my maize plot, not here. Beans do not need much, and I will use seed I saved from last season. I will work this plot myself with my family, weeding by hand, and I cannot afford to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
